summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on April 28, 2026, by Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. Shareholders approved three proposals: (1) a massive increase in authorized share capital, (2) adoption of an amended memorandum and articles to reflect that increase and written-resolutions provisions, and (3) authorization for the board to effect one or more reverse share splits over two years, with cumulative ratio not exceeding 1:5,000. The meeting achieved a quorum of ~67% of outstanding votes. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping measure, not a special situation.
